description: This Java class 'AttributeModifiedStrategy' handles attribute modification events in the context of Eclipse Ditto's thing event processing. It extends an abstract strategy class and applies attribute modifications to a ThingBuilder object based on incoming AttributeModified events.

classes.name: AttributeModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy for handling AttributeModified events by modifying a ThingBuilder instance accordingly.

methods.name: AttributeModifiedStrategy()
methods.description: Constructor for the AttributeModifiedStrategy class, initializes the strategy.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides superclass method to apply an AttributeModified event to a given ThingBuilder by setting an attribute with a pointer and value from the event.
